The Set KO Tourney's rules are listed.

The Set KO Tourney has special rules,
unlike standard battles.

First, one battle lasts only
three turns.

If the outcome is not decided after
three turns, it goes to judging.

The REFEREE will choose the winner
based on how the POKéMON battled.

Also, a POKéMON cannot be switched out
until its battle's outcome is decided.

The first judging factor is “Mind.”
This factor evaluates how aggressive
the battlers were.

The judging is based on how often
the TRAINERS ordered the use of
offensive moves.

The second judging factor is “Skill.”
This factor evaluates how effectively
POKéMON moves were used.

If a move worked successfully,
the Skill rating goes up.

If a move failed, the Skill rating
is lowered.

If it was an offensive move, the Skill
rating goes up if the move was “super
effective” and goes down if it was
“not very effective.”

The Skill rating will not go up for
moves such as PROTECT and DETECT.

If the opponent used PROTECT or
DETECT, and your POKéMON failed to
hit with a move, its Skill rating will not
go down.

The third judging factor is “Body.”
This factor is based on how much HP
remained at the end of a battle.

The rating takes into account how much
HP a POKéMON had at the start of
battle, and what remained at the end.

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_EventScript:
Is it your first time here?
Please step this way!

SCOTT: It's great to see you here,
it really is!

I hope you'll take your time and
explore everywhere.

Naturally, I hope you'll also experience
the pure essence of battling.

I also have my quarters here, so feel
free to visit if you have time.

We hope you enjoy all that the BATTLE
FRONTIER has to offer!

I'm your guide to the various facilities
here in the BATTLE FRONTIER.

It is the gigantic tower considered
to be the BATTLE FRONTIER's symbol.

There are four kinds of BATTLE ROOMS
in the tower for SINGLE, DOUBLE, MULTI,
and LINK MULTI BATTLES.

The BATTLE DOME is the large building
shaped like a huge egg.

Events named Battle Tourneys are held
in this facility.

The Battle Tourneys are offered in
two courses--for SINGLE and DOUBLE
BATTLES.

The BATTLE PALACE is the red building
on the right of the BATTLE FRONTIER.

There are two kinds of BATTLE HALLS
for SINGLE and DOUBLE BATTLES.

The BATTLE ARENA is the dojo-like
building at the center-right of
the BATTLE FRONTIER.

An event called the Set KO Tourney
takes place at the BATTLE ARENA.

The BATTLE FACTORY is the large
building that is the closest to us.

An event called the Battle Swap
is conducted there.

The Battle Swap event is offered in
two courses for SINGLE and DOUBLE
BATTLES.

The BATTLE PIKE is the building shaped
like a POKéMON at the center-left of
the BATTLE FRONTIER.

An event called the Battle Choice
is conducted there.

The BATTLE PYRAMID is the enormous
pyramid.

An event called the Battle Quest
is conducted there.

The RANKING HALL is located near
the BATTLE TOWER.

There, you may see the most fantastic
records left by the TRAINERS that
took on the many challenges of
the BATTLE FRONTIER.

The EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER is near
the BATTLE TOWER.

The Battle Points you have earned in
the BATTLE FRONTIER may be exchanged
for fabulous prizes there.

We hope you enjoy all that the BATTLE
FRONTIER has to offer!

I'm your guide to the basic rules that
are common to all the challenges
offered by the facilities in the BATTLE
FRONTIER.

All the challenges at the BATTLE
FRONTIER's facilities come in
two courses--Level 50 and Open Level.

The Level 50 course is open to POKéMON
up to and including Level 50.

Please keep in mind, however, that
no TRAINER you face will have any
POKéMON below Level 50.

This course is the entry level for
battles at the BATTLE FRONTIER.

To begin, we hope you will challenge
this course.

The Open Level course places no limit
on the levels of POKéMON entering
challenges.

The levels of your opponents will
be adjusted to match the levels of
your POKéMON.

However, no TRAINER you face will
have any POKéMON below Level 60.

Virtually any kind of POKéMON may take
on the challenges at all facilities.

EGGS and certain kinds of POKéMON,
however, are not permitted.

The numbers of POKéMON required for
challenges will depend on the facility.

At all facilities, however, two or more
of the same kind of POKéMON are not
permitted.

When entering a challenge at a BATTLE
FRONTIER facility, POKéMON may not
be holding the same kind of item.

Please make sure that all POKéMON
entering a challenge are holding
different items.

We hope you enjoy all that the BATTLE
FRONTIER has to offer!
I'm your guide to the FRONTIER PASS.

There are seven facilities at
the BATTLE FRONTIER.

TRAINERS who gain recognition for
their abilities may be rewarded with
symbols from each of the facilities.

To earn a symbol, TRAINERS may need
to defeat other TRAINERS in a row,
and may need to win events repeatedly.

It's certainly not easy to win symbols.
I wish you the best of luck!

It is possible to record one battle
on your FRONTIER PASS.

You may record a battle you had with
a friend or friends.

Or you may record a battle conducted
at the BATTLE FRONTIER excluding
matches at the BATTLE PIKE or
the BATTLE PYRAMID.

You may choose to record your match
at the end of a battle.

Battle Points are rewards given to
TRAINERS who battled outstandingly
at the BATTLE FRONTIER.

You may trade in your Battle Points
for prizes at the EXCHANGE SERVICE
CORNER.

We hope you enjoy all that the BATTLE
FRONTIER has to offer!

launching huge rockets.
MossdeepCity_EventScript_Sailor:
I heard from a SAILOR buddy that
TEAM AQUA set up shop in LILYCOVE.

I also heard that someone came along
and wiped the floor with them!

But MOSSDEEP here's been targeted
by that TEAM MAGMA.

If you want to know what they're up to,
go visit the SPACE CENTER.
MossdeepCity_EventScript_SailorMagmaGone:
I'm a SAILOR, so the sea's obviously
more important to me.

But you know? When I get back on land
after a long voyage, I do feel relief!
MossdeepCity_EventScript_NinjaBoy:
Around MOSSDEEP, you can see wild
WAILMER.

It's called, uh…
What was it now…

WAI, WAI, WAI…

WAILMER watching!
MossdeepCity_EventScript_ExpertM:
All life needs the sea to live, even
though it makes its home on the land.

Life, having run its course, becomes
soil and returns to the land.

And the sea is always connected to
the land.

Yes, like the very shoreline here.
MossdeepCity_EventScript_Girl:
Wouldn't it be nice?

If the whole world was covered in
plants and flowers like this island?
MossdeepCity_EventScript_Woman:
This rock has a special meaning to
the people at the SPACE CENTER.

They put it here as their wish for
their rockets to fly safely.

When you make a wish, what do you use?
Do you wish upon a star?

I use a wish tag to make it happen.
That's what I do.
MossdeepCity_EventScript_GymSign:
MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM
LEADERS: LIZA & TATE

“The mystic combination!”
MossdeepCity_EventScript_SpaceCenterSign:
MOSSDEEP SPACE CENTER
“The closest place to space.”
MossdeepCity_EventScript_Man:
A voyage on a ship is fine.

But crossing the sea with POKéMON
using SURF…

Now that's an exhilarating trip!
Wouldn't you agree, youngster?
MossdeepCity_EventScript_KingsRockBoy:
Why would you want it?
You're weird.

You can keep it, but keep it a secret
from STEVEN.
MossdeepCity_EventScript_ReceivedKingsRo: STEVEN's house is right over there!
MossdeepCity_EventScript_DeclineKingsRoc:
Yeah, you think so, too! What are you
supposed to do with some weird rock?
MossdeepCity_EventScript_BlackBelt:
Ahh… It feels great letting the waves
wash over my feet…

Speaking of the waves, you know that
island city SOOTOPOLIS?

I think the GYM there had a new
LEADER come in.

People tell me the new LEADER once
mentored WALLACE.
MossdeepCity_EventScript_Scott:
SCOTT: [PLAYER], feeling good?
I'm doing great!

I'd heard MOSSDEEP's GYM LEADER is
pretty strong, so I decided to come
take a look-see for myself.

But there's something wrong about
this town.

People are going on about a warning
letter and the SPACE CENTER…

I don't think it concerns me in any
way, though.
RS_MysteryEventsHouse_EventScript_Door: The door appears to be locked.
MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_TateAndLiza:
TATE: Looks like the bond between you
and your POKéMON is far stronger than
the bond that we share as twins.

LIZA: You will become even stronger!
We've battled you, so we know.

Registered GYM LEADERS TATE & LIZA
in the POKéNAV.
MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_GiveCalmMin:
TATE: That TM04 contains…
LIZA: CALM MIND!

TATE: It raises SP. ATK and…
LIZA: It raises SP. DEF!

TATE: It's a move that's perfect…
LIZA: For PSYCHIC POKéMON!

… … … … … …

TATE: That TM04 contains…
LIZA: CALM MIND!

TATE: It raises SP. ATK and…
LIZA: It raises SP. DEF!

TATE: It's a move that's perfect…
LIZA: For PSYCHIC POKéMON!

… … … … … …
MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_TateAndLiza:
TATE: You can knock us down,
but we'll never stay down!

LIZA: Because the two of us,
we always support each other!
MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_Preston:
The indecisive lose.
That's my warning to you.
MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_Virgil:
If there are prodigies in the world,
then our GYM LEADERS are them!

However, you may be even more talented
than them…
MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_Blake:
A POKé BALL was too heavy to lift
psychically. But this dust bunny…

Whoooooooooooooooh!
… … … … … …

No, I'm not cheating!
I didn't blow on it! Honestly!
MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_Hannah:
I'm not going to get down on myself for
losing. I just need to train harder.

Positive thinking--that's my strong
point!
MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_Samantha:
You will wage a terrifically intense
battle with our GYM LEADERS…

The result…
You won't hear it from me!
MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_Maura:
A bright future awaits those who have
worked diligently.

For those who lazed idly, there is
only despair at the end.

What goes around comes around…
MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_Sylvia:
How dare you beat me…

It won't be my fault if something
horrible befalls you…
MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_Nate:
I… I don't let defeat rattle m-me,
however b-badly.
MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_Macey:
Humph! You may be strong, but you're
not suitable for the PSYCHIC type!

The way you battle is somehow brutal!
MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_Clifford:
It seems that I could not overcome
your youthful energy.
MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_Nicholas:
All right! I think I'll develop a special
invincible POKéMON power next.
MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_Kathleen:
Your vitality is contagious!
Get away from me quickly!
MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_GymGuide:
Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-bound
[PLAYER]?

The GYM LEADERS here use
PSYCHIC-type POKéMON.

If you go up against them with
FIGHTING- or POISON-type POKéMON,
they'll inflict horrible damage!

Plus, they'll come at you with
outstanding combination attacks.

If you want to win, you'll need to show
them how tight you are with your
POKéMON. Go for it!
MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_GymGuidePos:
Wow, you're astounding!
You're one great TRAINER!
MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_GymStatueCe:
MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM

LIZA AND TATE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:
[PLAYER]
MossdeepCity_House1_EventScript_BlackBel:
It likes [...]S,
doesn't it?

No, I'm positive of it! It definitely
likes [...]S!
MossdeepCity_House1_EventScript_NeutralN:
It doesn't appear to like or dislike
any {POKEBLOCK}S.
MossdeepCity_House1_EventScript_Woman:
My husband can tell what kind of
{POKEBLOCK}S a POKéMON likes at a glance.
MossdeepCity_House2_EventScript_Man:
My little sister exchanges MAIL with
her boyfriend in FORTREE.

I don't envy her one bit at all.
MossdeepCity_House2_EventScript_Twin:
Even though I can't see my friend in
FORTREE, my POKéMON carries MAIL
back and forth for us.

I'm not lonesome, even though we're
apart.
MossdeepCity_House3_EventScript_SuperRod:
If there's any water, try dropping in
your ROD and see what bites!
MossdeepCity_House3_EventScript_Received:
Go after the seafloor POKéMON with
your SUPER ROD.
MossdeepCity_House3_EventScript_DeclineS:
Hunh?
Don't you like to fish?
MossdeepCity_House4_EventScript_Woman:
My little brother says he likes to go
find people's SECRET BASES.
MossdeepCity_House4_EventScript_CanBattl:
My little brother says he likes to
visit people's SECRET BASES and have
POKéMON battles.
MossdeepCity_House4_EventScript_NinjaBoy:
Was it you who made a SECRET BASE
near [...]?
MossdeepCity_House4_EventScript_NoSecret:
You should make a SECRET BASE
somewhere. I'll go find it!
MossdeepCity_Mart_EventScript_Woman:
REVIVE is fantastic!

Give it to a fainted POKéMON,
and the POKéMON will arise.

But be careful, REVIVE doesn't restore
the used-up PP of moves.
MossdeepCity_Mart_EventScript_Boy:
MAX REPEL keeps all weak POKéMON away.

Out of all the REPEL sprays, it lasts
the longest.
MossdeepCity_Mart_EventScript_Sailor:
The NET and DIVE BALLS are rare POKé
BALLS that are only made in MOSSDEEP.

A NET BALL is effective against
BUG-type and WATER-type POKéMON.

A DIVE BALL works best on POKéMON
at the bottom of the sea.
MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_1F_EventScrip:
The GYM LEADERS in this town are
a formidable duo.

Their combination attacks are, like,
excellent and wow!

Depending on the special abilities of
POKéMON, some moves might change
or not work at all.
MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_2F_EventScrip:
If I win a whole lot of link battles
and show everyone how good I am,
I might get a fan following!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_EventScript_: The rocket's launch is imminent!

The rocket launched safely!
That's successful launch no. [...]!

I know that things are a little
haywire right now, but…

The rocket's launch is imminent!

I know that things are a little
haywire right now, but…

The rocket launched safely!
That's successful launch no. [...]!

A rocket launch demands perfection.
Not even a 1% margin of error is allowed.

Even if it's 99% okay, the whole thing
is useless if 1% happens to be no good.

Despite that, we never stop trying.
Why? It's a dream that never ends.

Those MAGMA thugs have their sights
set on our SPACE CENTER.

But we can't allow anything that minor
to interfere with our rocket launch!

The HOENN region has been famous for 
its meteor showers for a long time.

The HOENN region has been famous for 
its meteor showers for a long time.

With TEAM MAGMA around, I guess
strolls on the beach aren't safe.

With TEAM MAGMA around, I guess
strolls on the beach aren't safe.

Some people claim that POKéMON came
from space. Could it be true?

TEAM AQUA should take care of
TEAM MAGMA!

But if they did that, TEAM AQUA will
become bold and brazen, won't they?

A giant chunk of metal bursts through
the skies and flies into space…

It boggles my mind!

A giant chunk of metal bursts through
the skies and flies into space…

But TEAM MAGMA wants to spoil
that dream of mine!

I'm not having any of that!

STEVEN: [PLAYER], have you read that
proclamation already?

TEAM MAGMA is coming after the rocket
fuel on this island.

I don't know what they'd need it for,
but they can't be allowed to take it.

I'll keep an eye on things for
a while longer.

In the meantime, why don't you go
check out the town?

This is…
An intent-to-steal notice?

“To the staff of the SPACE CENTER:
How are you? We are doing fine.

“We will soon visit you to take your
rocket fuel.

“Please don't try to stop us.
We will take the fuel no matter what.

“Let there be more land!
                                          TEAM MAGMA”

Don't think you're on a roll just
because you've beaten me!

Okay, I get it already! The next time,
we'll come unannounced.

What are we going to do with
the rocket fuel?

How would I know?
Ask our leader upstairs!

Our leader said no one, but no one,
gets past me!

Please, tell our leader that
I never abandoned my post.
That I stayed to the bitter end…
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_EventScript_:
Good answer!
That's what a smart person'll do!

I bet you want to take a break.
But I'm not about to let you do that!

MOSSDEEP has mainly sunny weather,
and its winds are stable.

It's an ideal location for launching
rockets.

Why would TEAM MAGMA want to steal
our rocket fuel in the first place?

If only I was a little younger, I would
have liked being an astronaut…

No… It's not too late!
I can and will try!

If TEAM MAGMA takes the rocket fuel,
I won't be able to go to space!

They can't be allowed to get away
with such an outrage!

I wish ordinary people could go into
space one day…

TEAM MAGMA…
Do they want to go to space, too?

Three of us here, and look at the sorry
mess we got ourselves into.

We three losing like this…
We look worse than usual by triple!

Are we being useful to our leader
at all?

Hehehe!

We come all the way here to get some
fuel, and we're interfered with again!

If you're going to mess with us too,
we'll take care of you at the same time!

MAXIE: Clear out of the way!
Don't you dare interfere!

MAXIE: Fufufu… Since you're so
curious, you deserve an explanation.

We're going to jettison the entire
load into MT. CHIMNEY!

With GROUDON gone, we have no need
for that slag heap of a mountain!

So we'll use the fuel's power to make
the volcano erupt!

It will be savage!

STEVEN: Then, hurry!
Get ready quickly!

STEVEN: Whew, that was too tense.
[PLAYER], thank you.

I have something to give you as
thanks for your support.

Please come see me at home
after this.

Oh, yes, I don't live in RUSTBORO CITY.
I live right here on this island.
MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_EventScript_St:
STEVEN: While you're using SURF, you
should notice dark patches of water.

Use DIVE if you come to deep water
like it. You'll drop to the seafloor.

When you want to come back up, use
DIVE again.

In some places, it won't be possible
for you to surface, though.
MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_EventScript_Be:
[PLAYER] checked the POKé BALL.

It contained the POKéMON
BELDUM.

Take the POKé BALL?
MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_EventScript_Le:
[PLAYER] left the POKé BALL where
it was.
MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_EventScript_Ro:
It's a collection of rare rocks and
stones assembled by STEVEN.
MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_EventScript_St:
STEVEN: Apparently, there's an
underwater cavern between
MOSSDEEP and SOOTOPOLIS.

You know, the one that CAPT. STERN
found in his submarine.
MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_EventScript_Le:
It's a letter.

… … … … … …

To [PLAYER]…

I've decided to do a little soul-
searching and train on the road.

I don't plan to return home for some
time.

I have a favor to ask of you.

I want you to take the POKé BALL on
the desk.

Inside it is a BELDUM, my favorite
POKéMON.

I'm counting on you.

May our paths cross someday.

STEVEN STONE
MtChimney_EventScript_ArchieGoStopTeamMa:
ARCHIE: Grr, [PLAYER]!
I should've guessed you'd show up!

See for yourself what the fanatics
of TEAM MAGMA are up to!

They're trying to inject the stolen
METEORITE's power into the volcano!

Doing something like that will cause
the volcano's eruption!
MtChimney_EventScript_ArchieBusyFighting:
ARCHIE: Grrr…

I want to stop that MAXIE,
but I can't!

Not when I have my hands full battling
three opponents at once!
MtChimney_EventScript_Maxie:
ARCHIE: [PLAYER]!
Thank you!

With your help, we thwarted TEAM
MAGMA's destructive plan!

But… You…
Whose side are you on?

Ah, it doesn't matter.

We will remain vigilant and keep up
our pursuit of TEAM MAGMA.

[PLAYER], we shall meet again!
MtChimney_EventScript_NotEnoughMoney:
Oh, dear. You can't buy a thing if
you've not got the money.
MtChimney_EventScript_BusyAquaGrunt1:
Darn… TEAM MAGMA outnumbers us!
We can't keep up with them!
MtChimney_EventScript_BusyAquaGrunt2:
If they expand the land, there'll be
less habitats for WATER POKéMON!
MtChimney_EventScript_BusyAquaGrunt3:
We're TEAM AQUA!

They're TEAM MAGMA!

It burns me up that they'd use such
a confusing name!
MtChimney_EventScript_Tabitha:
BOSS, hurry!
Give it the METEORITE's energy!

Hehehe…
MtChimney_EventScript_Grunt2:
Our BOSS says, “It will make everyone
happy.”

But why does everyone keep getting
in our way?
MtChimney_EventScript_BusyMagmaGrunt1:
That annoying TEAM AQUA…
They always mess with our plans!
MtChimney_EventScript_BusyMagmaGrunt3:
You'd better not mess with us!

We're trying to awaken that thing
for the benefit of everyone!
MtChimney_EventScript_BusyMagmaGrunt4:
We're TEAM MAGMA!

They're TEAM AQUA!

It totally annoys me that they'd
use a name like ours!
MtChimney_EventScript_BusyMagmaGrunt6: We're going to keep making more land!
MtChimney_EventScript_MeteoriteMachine:
[PLAYER] removed the METEORITE from
the mysterious machine.
MtChimney_EventScript_LeaveMeteoriteAlon:
[PLAYER] left the METEORITE where
it was.
MtChimney_EventScript_MachineOff:
This mysterious machine…
It makes no response whatsoever.
MtChimney_EventScript_MachineOn:
A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious
machine…

The machine seems to be storing
energy in the METEORITE.
MtChimney_EventScript_Shelby:
Well, well, I've lost. I can't call
myself an EXPERT now, can I?
MtChimney_EventScript_DefeatedShelby:
Thank you, child. It was fun, as if
I were battling my own grandchild.

Please, come see me again for
a rematch.
MtChimney_EventScript_RematchShelby:
Perhaps your heart has become one
with the hearts of your POKéMON.
MtChimney_EventScript_Melissa:
The heat of MT. CHIMNEY warms
me up, baby!
MtChimney_EventScript_Sheila:
Like I said, I've finally made it to
MT. CHIMNEY. It would be a shame if
I only do a little sightseeing…

I want to get in some battles and buy
COOKIES as souvenirs.
MtChimney_EventScript_Shirley:
I'll have to take another dip in the
hot springs. Want to join me?

Just joking!
MtChimney_EventScript_Grunt1:
A kid like you, you ought to be
splashing about in the waves!
MtChimney_EventScript_Sawyer:
I think I need a dip in LAVARIDGE
HOT SPRING with the locals!
MtChimney_EventScript_SawyerDefeated:
I like little fireballs like you.
Let me register you in my POKéNAV.
MtChimney_EventScript_SawyerRematch:
Actually, it really is hot here.
I'm overdressed for these parts.
MtChimney_CableCarStation_EventScript_At:
The CABLE CAR is ready to go down.
Would you like to be on it?
MtChimney_CableCarStation_EventScript_De: Please ride with us another time.
MtPyre_1F_EventScript_CleanseTagWoman:
All sorts of beings wander the slopes
of MT. PYRE…

There is no telling what may happen.
Take this. It's for your own good.
MtPyre_1F_EventScript_ReceivedCleanseTag:
Have a POKéMON hold that
CLEANSE TAG.

It will help ward off wild POKéMON.
MtPyre_1F_EventScript_PokefanF:
Did you come to pay your respect
to the spirits of departed POKéMON?

You must care for your POKéMON a lot.
MtPyre_1F_EventScript_Man:
This is the final resting place of my
ZIGZAGOON. I cherished it…
MtPyre_2F_EventScript_Woman:
Memories of my darling SKITTY…
My eyes overflow thinking about it.
MtPyre_2F_EventScript_PokefanM:
Ooch, ouch… There are holes in the
ground here and there.

I didn't notice and took a tumble from
the floor above.
MtPyre_2F_EventScript_Mark:
People don't come here often, so
I thought there'd be rare POKéMON.
MtPyre_2F_EventScript_Luke:
LUKE: Well, we lost but that's okay!
I'm right here by your side.
We'll make it through this dare!
MtPyre_2F_EventScript_Dez:
DEZ: We're lovey-dovey, so we don't
care if we lose!
MtPyre_2F_EventScript_Leah:
Our family has been TRAINERS here
since my great-grandmother's time…

It is my duty to protect this
mountain…
MtPyre_2F_EventScript_Zander:
I get freaked out every time I see
anything move…

I shouldn't have come here to train…
MtPyre_3F_EventScript_William:
My psychic powers have surely
grown several times, but…
MtPyre_3F_EventScript_Kayla:
This means my training is still not
enough…

I've got to keep working toward the
summit…

Go, me!
MtPyre_3F_EventScript_Gabrielle:
POKéMON no longer of this world.
POKéMON that are with you now.

And the POKéMON that you will meet
in the future…

They are all to be equally cherished.
Please remember that.
MtPyre_3F_EventScript_RegisterGabrielle:
I would like to see your POKéMON
when they grow up some more…

Please, I need to see your POKéNAV.
MtPyre_3F_EventScript_RematchGabrielle:
POKéMON no longer of this world.
POKéMON that are with you now.

And the POKéMON that you will meet
in the future…

They are all to be equally cherished.
I see that you've remembered that.
MtPyre_5F_EventScript_Atsushi:
Until I improve, my teacher, who rests
here, will never find true peace…
MtPyre_4F_EventScript_Tasha:
I want to see dreadful things…
I can't leave…

Stay…
Won't you stay with me?
MtPyre_6F_EventScript_Valerie:
Perhaps the power is from the spirits
of POKéMON in fitful sleep here…
MtPyre_6F_EventScript_RegisterValerie:
Fufufu… I lost the match, but…
I have this little ability…

Without ever laying my hands on
your POKéNAV… Hiyah!
MtPyre_6F_EventScript_RematchValerie:
The POKéMON at rest here…
Sometimes, they play…
MtPyre_6F_EventScript_Cedric:
I had this feeling that a lost TRAINER
would be panicked and easy to beat.

It's dirty and I won't try it again…
MtPyre_Summit_EventScript_TeamAquaExits:
Oh, no…
This cannot happen…

Not only the BLUE ORB, but even
the RED ORB has been taken…

The BLUE ORB and RED ORB must never
be separated. They belong together.

What are those men trying to do with
the two ORBS?

… … … … … …
… … … … … …

Oh, yes. Was it TEAM MAGMA who came
and took the BLUE ORB first?

Well, in their haste, they left this
behind.

I couldn't imagine what exactly it
could be.

I would like you to have it.
Perhaps it will be useful in some way.
MtPyre_Summit_EventScript_OldMan:
MT. PYRE is where we calm the spirits
of POKéMON that have passed on…

This is a high place where one can
see all of HOENN…

The disembodied spirits of POKéMON
must find solace here…

Is it coincidence that you are here…

Will you hear out my tale? A tale long
told in the HOENN region?
MtPyre_Summit_EventScript_OldManAfterRay:
It is my role to pass on the legends
of HOENN to future generations.

And the crisis that just ended in
SOOTOPOLIS rewrote a legend…

Have you the time to hear the new
legend of HOENN?
MtPyre_Summit_EventScript_OldManTale:
It happened long, long ago…

The world was wracked by a ferocious
clash between the POKéMON of the land
and the POKéMON of the sea…

The POKéMON of the land raised
mountains and created continents…

The POKéMON of the sea raised huge
waves and carved out oceans…

Their fierce duel raged without end.

The world was engulfed in massive
infernos and vicious storms.

The BLUE ORB and the RED ORB brought
an end to the calamity.

Light poured from the two ORBS and
becalmed the enraged adversaries.

The pair, made docile, dove deep into
the sea where eventually they
disappeared…
MtPyre_Summit_EventScript_DeclineOldManT:
I see…
Well, that, too, is fine…
MtPyre_Summit_EventScript_OldManNewTale:
It happened long, long ago…

The world was wracked by a ferocious
clash between the POKéMON of the land
and the POKéMON of the sea…

The POKéMON of the land raised
mountains and created continents…

The POKéMON of the sea raised huge
waves and carved out oceans…

Their fierce duel raged without end.

The world was engulfed in massive
fires and vicious storms.

It was then that the POKéMON of
the sky descended from a storm.

The POKéMON, shining a vivid green,
becalmed the two enraged POKéMON.

Then, its duty done, the green POKéMON
flew off into the wild blue yonder…
MtPyre_Summit_EventScript_OldLady:
The BLUE ORB and RED ORB taken by
those sinister men…

They must never be apart…
I fear something terrible will happen…
MtPyre_Summit_EventScript_OldLadyOrbsRet:
The two men who took the ORBS came
back to return them on their own.

Those men…
Perhaps they are not so evil after all…
MtPyre_Summit_EventScript_OldLadyLegenda:
Oh, my goodness…

You say that both GROUDON and KYOGRE
have been awakened?

It is said that the BLUE ORB and
the RED ORB quelled the rage of
the two POKéMON…

It is also said that the true owner
of the ORBS still exists.

However, no one knows who, or what
exactly, the ORBS belong to.

It could be a human, or perhaps
a POKéMON, but no one knows.
MtPyre_Summit_EventScript_OldLadyAfterOr:
The embodiments of the land, sea,
and the sky…

At first, we had a huge work crew boring
through rock with the latest machinery.
But, we had to stop.

It turns out that we would have had
a negative effect on wild POKéMON in
the area.

So, we've got nothing to do but loll
around here doing nothing.

There's a man digging his way to
VERDANTURF all by his lonesome.
He's desperate to get through.

He says that if he digs little by little
without using machines, he won't
disturb POKéMON, and he'll avoid
harming the natural environment.

I wonder if he made it through yet.

To get to VERDANTURF without using
this TUNNEL, you'd have to cross the
sea to DEWFORD, sail on to SLATEPORT,
then travel through MAUVILLE.

Did you hear? The TUNNEL to VERDANTURF
has gone through!

Sometimes, if you hope strongly enough,
dreams do come true.

Wow, you're really strong!

I wish I could be a POKéMON TRAINER
like you!

While I was sleeping, everyone went
upstairs!

we study the weather patterns over
the HOENN region.

We've been noticing temporary and
isolated cases of droughts and
heavy rain lately…

The PROFESSOR loves rain.
That's a fact.

But if it keeps raining, people will be in
trouble. That's another fact.

And thus, the PROFESSOR is studying
if the rain can be put to good use.

Hello!
We've been saved by your actions!

What I don't understand is what on
earth the AQUAS were up to.

There's a bed…
Let's take a rest.

Our BOSS knows everything.

But I'm just a GRUNT. What would I know
about what he's thinking?

Oh, no…
I'll catch an earful for losing to a kid…

I should just take a nap in the bed…

Humph, so what?

What we really want isn't here…
Ihihihihi…

If the POKéMON they made here can
control the weather freely, then we of
TEAM AQUA definitely need it!

You don't have any idea what we of
TEAM AQUA are working towards!
You stay out of our way!

blunder about, but now there's you!

in our business, anyway?

What?!

We can't waste any more time here!
We have to hurry to MT. PYRE, too!

Ahahahaha!
TEAM MAGMA, just you wait!

Thanks!
Thanks to you, we're safe!

but take this POKéMON.

to the weather conditions.

There're plenty of them in the
INSTITUTE--go ahead and take it.

I've been researching rain for many
years, but it's ridiculous to think that
humans can freely change the weather.

I track weather patterns over
the HOENN region.

Presently, a drought has been recorded
in [...].

Could that mean, somewhere near
[...]…

I track weather patterns over
the HOENN region.

Presently, heavy rainfall has been
recorded over [...].

Could that mean, somewhere near
[...]…

Abnormal weather conditions are
no longer being reported.

The occasional rainfall is a blessing,
really.
